title: Range Sum of Sorted Subarray Sums
description: Calculate the sum of elements from index left to right in a sorted array of all subarray sums of an input array.
pseudocode:
1. sums = []
2. for i from 0 to n-1:
3.   currentSum = 0
4.   for j from i to n-1:
5.     currentSum += nums[j]
6.     sums.push(currentSum)
7. sums.sort((a,b) => a-b)
8. return sum of sums[left-1...right-1]

steps.note: Initialize empty array to store all subarray sums.
i=0, j=0: Calculate first subarray sum [1].
